name: What is the standard step-by-step process for drywall installation?

mainEntity.name: What is the standard step-by-step process for drywall installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professional drywall installation follows four key phases: framing inspection, hanging sheetrock, taping and mudding, and final texturing or sanding. At HH Remodeling, owner Abraham Becerra verifies custom framing, plumbing rough-ins, and electrical boxes before hanging boards. The crew fastens the drywall panels, applies joint tape, and adds multiple coats of joint compound, letting each layer dry completely. After sanding smooth, surfaces are primed and textured or prepped for interior paint. Basement buildouts or whole-room additions require this structured sequence to prevent uneven seams and visible fasteners later.
acceptedAnswer.description: Drywall installation involves framing verification, hanging sheetrock, taping, applying multiple coats of mud, and sanding or texturing before painting.
